notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ عَبْدُ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ اَلْحَجَّاجِ»: the asker is a link (rule 5). The one asked is a pronoun, and no previous report is in the context to name him, so he is not written. «إِنَّ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» is the speaker's own father inside the words, not a link. The route is incomplete.
